description_en: Queries the list of devices that are imported in a batch based on the application batch ID (ApplyId)
description_zh: 调用该接口根据申请批次ID（ApplyId）查询批量导入的设备列表
name: QueryImportedDeviceByApplyId

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，默认值为10，最大值不超过50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The application batch ID of the devices to query. You can obtain the application batch ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433878.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 要查询设备的申请批次ID。申请批次ID可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433878.html接口返回结果中查看
parameters.name: apply_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~10,000
parameters.name: page_no

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageNo.description_en: The page number of the returned results
PageNo.description_zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the returned results
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

TotalPage.description_en: The total number of pages in the returned results
